name: Random Picker
description: Roll dice, flip a coin, pick a number or choose from your own list. Shake to roll.
prompt: A random picker with four modes: up to five dice with total, a flipping coin, a random number in a range without repeats, and picking from my own list, with shake to roll.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Tira dados, lanza una moneda, saca un número o elige de tu propia lista. Agita para tirar.
